description: Ramelig: generates a melody one note at a time, choosing at each trigger between stepping up, stepping down, staying put, jumping away or shifting to a new centre

params.text: Sets the bottom of the range the melody keeps to, -10V to 10V
Sets the top of the range the melody keeps to, -10V to 10V
Sets the relative likelihood of jumping to a random note and heading back towards the old one afterwards, 0 to 10
Forces the next trigger to jump, whatever the likelihoods say; a forced jump beats a forced shift
Sets the relative likelihood of moving to a random note and carrying on from there, 0 to 10, despite the panel printing MOVE where the maker calls it Shift
Forces the next trigger to shift to a new centre, whatever the likelihoods say
Sets the relative likelihood of stepping up, 0 to 10, against all the other actions
Sets the relative likelihood of repeating the current note, 0 to 10, against all the other actions
Sets the relative likelihood of stepping down, 0 to 10, against all the other actions
Sets how likely a step is to be two scale notes rather than one: at 0 every step is one note, at 10 every step is two
Reduces the likelihood of a repeat following a repeat: at 0 a repeat never follows a repeat, at 10 the repeat likelihood is untouched
Picks which of the twelve stored scales is in use
Adds or removes that note from the scale in use
Generates the next note when clicked, with a short gate on the trigger output

inputs.text: Generates the next note each time it rises to 1V; the output gate lasts as long as this one stays high
Adds to the lower limit, with the total held between -10V and 10V
Adds to the upper limit, with the total held between -10V and 10V
Adds to the jump likelihood, one unit per volt, with the total held between 0 and 10
Adds to the shift likelihood, one unit per volt, with the total held between 0 and 10
Adds to the up-step likelihood, one unit per volt, with the total held between 0 and 10
Adds to the repeat likelihood, one unit per volt, with the total held between 0 and 10
Adds to the down-step likelihood, one unit per volt, with the total held between 0 and 10
Changes the scale in use while it is patched, added to the scale knob and wrapping round

outputs.text: The pitch of the current note, as a 1V/octave voltage
A gate each time a note is generated, as long as the gate on the trigger input

notes: nothing happens until a trigger arrives or the trigger button is clicked: changes to any other control take effect only at the next trigger
a polyphonic cable on the trigger input runs one independent melody per channel; a monophonic CV input then applies to all of them, and a polyphonic one is taken channel by channel
the scale never becomes polyphonic: one scale applies to every channel, and a polyphonic scale input is read on its first channel
if a step would leave the range, the opposite step is taken instead; if the limits cross, the lower of the two is used as the bottom
the upper bar shows the current likelihoods and the lower bar shows the position of the current note within the range, both in the colours marked beside each action's knob
menu: Scale CV mode: Decimal (0V-10V), Chromatic (1V/Oct) — chooses whether the scale input is read as the 0V to 10V range split into twelve or as a note pitch whose name picks the scale
